findings.distinction: Episode/category credit is distinct from recalling or reconstructing content.
findings.blockedClaim: The bounded consolidation witness solves arbitrary correlated evidence fusion.
findings.reopen: Reconstruction feeds learning or a new consumer combines correlated episode/summary sources.

findings.distinction: Prediction residual is an audit readout of expectation and admitted outcome.
findings.blockedClaim: A new surprise state,privileged truth comparator or calibrated confidence was qualified.
findings.reopen: A new prediction-error consumer or uncertainty/calibration law is proposed.

findings.distinction: Threat with continuation is bounded operational fear without compulsory protective action.
findings.blockedClaim: Literal flight,general fear repertoire or clinical syndrome was simulated.
findings.reopen: A required natural or physical threat behavior exceeds the existing response profile.

findings.distinction: Coverage reconciliation and later bounded successors are distinct from new runtime execution and campaign exit.
findings.blockedClaim: Twenty audited partials or zero later partials waive history/corpus/family/native gates.
findings.reopen: Final exit requires explicit accepted dispositions under the authority hierarchy.

findings.distinction: Importance and urgency can remain semantic operands without an independently stored importance cell.
findings.blockedClaim: Equal current scalar erases future distinction or Refold proves general history compression.
findings.reopen: Incomplete history,new updates or a new consumer changes the permitted future queries.
